results.description: An enterprise-grade Agentic Telecom Support Assistant using LangGraph, RAG, FastAPI, Streamlit, and Azure AI Foundry for automated issue triage, troubleshooting, ticketing, and escalation.

An intelligent, context-aware decision-support agent for steel manufacturing assets. Integrates live cyber-physical telemetry, RAG-driven technical manual/SOP lookup, predictive RUL analytics, and automated root cause analysis (RCA). Features a multi-turn troubleshooting assistant with a human-in-the-loop engineering feedback system.
End goal is something similar to Jarvis from Iron Man.  A complete assistant that can do anything.
AI-powered assistant for diagnosing latency issues in storage systems using LLMs, RAG, and visual insights. Built to simplify troubleshooting in modern storage infrastructures.

An intelligent Network Troubleshooting Assistant that leverages LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and a fallback mechanism to provide accurate network diagnostics and solutions.
